title: "error: resource mipmap/icon_background not found" when building for Meta Quest
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.5.dev.custom_build [7459a0361]

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (7459a0361) - macOS Sequoia (15.3.1) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon Pro 5500 XT OpenGL Engine - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700K CPU @ 3.80GHz (16 threads)

### Issue description

After installing the Android export template produced as an artifact from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/actions/runs/13731276876, attempting to build my project for my Meta Quest headset results in the following output:
```

> A failure occurred while executing com.android.build.gradle.internal.res.LinkApplicationAndroidResourcesTask$TaskAction
   > Android resource linking failed
     com.godot.game-mergeStandardDebugResources-16:/values/values.xml:122: error: resource mipmap/icon_background (aka com.meorge.ontheclockvr:mipmap/icon_background) not found.
     com.godot.game-mergeStandardDebugResources-16:/values/values.xml:122: error: resource mipmap/icon_background (aka com.meorge.ontheclockvr:mipmap/icon_background) not found.
     error: failed linking references.

> Run with --stacktrace option to get the stack trace.

```
To confirm it wasn't an issue with something in my project, I tried downloading the [Godot XR Template project](https://github.com/GodotVR/godot-xr-template/) and building it. I got the same error there. As such I'm thinking this is a bug with the engine.

### Steps to reproduce

Install the [Android export template from Godot's GitHub actions artifacts](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/actions/runs/13731276876).
Download the [Godot XR Template project](https://github.com/GodotVR/godot-xr-template/). Install the Android build template in the project, and then build the project for Meta Quest.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A (use template project and steps described above)
